title: Install and verify Clew
summary: Install and verify Clew under email admission maintenance, preserve its application ledger, and prepare or restore the daily email schedule.

consumers.statement: The authorized local installer and Cell deployment coordinator.

preconditions.statement: A validated committed candidate and compatible Platter, Email and Clockwork interfaces are available. Coordinated mutations require drained run-owned email maintenance.

inputs.statement: Use deploy.sh plan clew then deploy.sh clew from committed local main. The boolean daily_email_enabled setting changes daily intent; omission preserves it. Direct install accepts absolute --binary, --bundle and optional --home. schedule-definition requires existing state and a new absolute output file.

outputs.statement: The selected immutable release contains clew, clew-install and the matching Chancery provider. Coordinated configure initializes empty schema-one state.

data_semantics.statement: Installation is program selection and empty-ledger initialization. It creates no application entries and supplies no statuses.

identity_and_units.statement: Content hashes identify immutable releases; package version, provider contract and database schema are separate identities.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: Verification checks the selected installed bytes, local ledger integrity and the retained Platter read interface at that invocation. It establishes no future availability.

access.statement: The current user owns installation selectors and private ledger state.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: The shared file transaction selects commands and provider atomically. Lifecycle captures, suspends and drains email work, prepares the exact disabled definition, then restores enabled intent after releasing its hold. Failure halts and both databases are preserved. Ledger writers remain compatible across program selection.

operational_limits.statement: There is no completion-time guarantee. Concurrent schema-one readers and short SQLite writers can finish across program selection.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: Only cell-install-v2 releases, ledger schema one and email schema one are supported. Contract two adds guarded daily schedule lifecycle. Disable the daily binding before rollback to a program without email support and preserve all delivery records.

reliances.statement: Clew requires the Platter opportunity reader for first-reference admission and search.
Email submits the unchanged payload and stable key to the fixed recipient.
Clockwork activates the installed runner and enforces scheduling failure halts.

use_when: Installing, checking or recovering the Clew command and private ledger.
do_not_use_when: Recording an application update or changing Platter preparation.
outcome: Verified installed Clew commands, provider and compatible empty or existing ledger.
effects: Program deployment selects immutable files and initializes a missing ledger without creating entries. Existing rows remain intact.
The coordinator holds email admission and suspends scheduling while preparing the selected release. Activation restores captured or explicitly supplied intent without approving a halt.
authority: Clew owns its installation and ledger; the shared coordinator owns deployment ordering.
Clockwork owns schedule enforcement; enabling daily_email_enabled explicitly grants standing authority for the Clew digest.
success: Installed bytes match the selected candidate, ledger integrity passes and the retained Platter read interface succeeds.
failure_and_recovery: File recovery selects a coherent prior or candidate release without restoring or deleting the ledger. Preserve unresolved installation evidence. Unsupported or nonempty foreign state fails.
Retain email occurrences and uncertain acceptance across recovery. Resolve product and schedule selection before releasing run-owned admission; never erase or approve existing failure incidents.
privacy: Private ledger state is outside source and installation releases.
does_not_authorize: Adding application records, deleting history, immediate test mail, implicit first-time schedule enablement, or approval of a failure halt.
